audience: trade and field service firms that run jobs, bookings and quotes in ServiceM8

useCases.title: Find jobs that wait for a quote
useCases.text: List jobs filtered by status, such as Quote, then open one to read its address, client and description.

useCases.title: Plan the bookings for one client
useCases.text: Read the scheduled bookings of the jobs and the on-site contacts for each job. Read the client record for the account details.

useCases.title: Check staff and dispatch queues
useCases.text: List the staff members with their roles and active flag, and the job queues that hold unassigned jobs.

useCases.title: Create a job or change its status
useCases.text: Create a job for a client with a status and a purchase order number. Update the status or fields of an existing job.

useCases.title: Review materials and photos on a job
useCases.text: List the material lines of quotes and invoices with quantity and price, and the attachment records of a job.
